headline: Call of the Haunted
title: Call of the Haunted Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Call of the Haunted. What is it? It is a Continuous Trap Card, and a classic way to revive monsters. What does it do? Target one monster in your Graveyard and Special Summon it in Attack Position. If this card leaves the field, that monster is destroyed, and if that monster is destroyed, this card goes too. How do you use it? Set it, then flip it on your opponent's turn to bring back your strongest monster as a surprise blocker, or to get a monster back for a Tribute or a Synchro Summon. Protect the card, because losing it also loses the monster. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
